stanzas: When conflict comes I look in first
I replay every word that hurt
I search my soul for what it meant
After most folks would move on
I did wrong I look for the cracks in me
Thinking maybe that's the way to breathe
I hold the truth in my desire
I wanna fix and make it right
So I keep checking late through the night
I give the benefit of the doubt everybody else
I try to own my part owning all of it
I can feel the wound and the why
See the stress behind their eyes
Fold it in I give them grace
Wonder why I still feel burned
I grieve Like my own pain
Then ask my heart to speak by name
I'm trying hard to be that fair
Self-reflection I give the benefit of the doubt to
Everybody else But I don't give me mercy
I owe myself try hold my part without owning all
Of it deep inside my heart
Maybe the truth is not a trial
Maybe I don't need to wait this while
And still not turn hard as
I can be fair and still need help
I give the benefit of the doubt to everybody else
